fbs_normal.en: Your fasting blood sugar is in the normal range. Keep eating a balanced diet with plenty of vegetables, fruit, and whole grains, and stay active most days.
fbs_normal.gil: E raoiroi tiokam imwain te amwarake. Teimatoa ni kanii amwarake aika raoiroi n aron uani kai ao bae ni kai, ai amwarake aika tuai tia aroia, ao kakorakoraa ni kakmwakura rabwatam n angiin bong.

fbs_prediabetes.en: Your fasting blood sugar is a little higher than normal. Cut back on sugary drinks and white rice/bread, eat more vegetables and fish, and try to walk regularly. Talk to a nurse or doctor about this reading.
fbs_prediabetes.gil: Tiokam imwain te amwarake ea rietata riki nakon are e riai. Kauarerea kanakin moi aika karewe ao te raiti ma kariki aika mainaina, kabatia te baenikai ao te uani kai, ao te ika, ao kataia n nakonako n angiin bong. Maroroa ma am neeti ke te taokita ibukin riki tiokam.

fbs_diabetes.en: Your fasting blood sugar is in the diabetes range. Please see a doctor or nurse soon. In the meantime, avoid sugary drinks and snacks, favor vegetables, fish, and small portions of rice, and stay active.
fbs_diabetes.gil: Tiokam imwain te amwarake ea kaotia ae koa tioka. Taiaoka kawara te taokita ke te neeti n te tai ae waekoa. N te tai aei, tai nim moi ao amwarake aika a karewe, moi ran, kabatia te baenikai ao te uani kai, te ika, ao te raiti tii teutana, ao teimatoa ni kakamwakura rabwatam.
